📖 How to use

  1. Enter your current annual salary.
  2. Enter the raise percentage.
  3. Read your new salary and the monthly/annual increase.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the new salary calculated?

New salary = current salary × (1 + raise% ÷ 100). Annual increase = new − current; monthly increase = annual increase ÷ 12.

Can I combine merit and promotion raises?

Yes — enter the total as one percentage (e.g. 7% for a 4% merit raise plus 3% promotion bump).

Is this after tax?

No — this is gross pay before taxes. Your take-home increase will be smaller after taxes and deductions.
